title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns Amid Investigation
excerpt: Nvidia cofounder and CEO Jensen Huang stepped down following the launch of an investigation into an affair with an alleged Chinese intelligence asset.
body_html:
Nvidia cofounder and chief executive Jensen Huang stepped down from his position on Thursday. The resignation followed the initiation of an internal investigation by the company.

According to the company's actions, the inquiry was opened into Huang's affair with an alleged Chinese intelligence asset. No further details regarding the ongoing investigation or leadership succession were immediately provided in the announcement.
